decisions.reason: Traces session/tool worker into the host process running from the npm-targeted package; host dies at linkStuff, GUI disconnects, tool outcome preserved as unknown; rejects the network-failure reading and only claims this in-session same-package case is fatal.

Shims generated only at bin-linking: old removed, new never written; dsh/dsh.cmd missing, dsh.ps1 stale into the old tree; content presence proves nothing; ties the hand-swapped nonstandard tree to the broken shims and rejects hand repair.

Grounds the pinned external rerun in repair-notes.md so npm regenerates shims, verifies dsh --version = rc.1, covers checkout tag alignment without unrelated edits, and keeps recorded repair separate from proposed verification.

Recognizes self-upgrade and refuses any form of in-session execution; procedure stops the host before the exact-pinned install then restarts/refreshes/verifies; stop-first and pinning labeled established rules, refusal-from-inside the new self-host rule; the handed procedure's shell must not be a dsh tool worker.

Pre-execution guard matching the install target to the host's own package path; uses the version-only alpha.5→rc.1 diff to skip re-migration; checks version markers and actual plugin loading after restart/refresh with backup cleanup only after verification; no code change.

caps.reason: Final plan explicitly refuses in-session execution and mandates an external pinned install.
Manual swaps/shims are analyzed as aggravating failures and explicitly rejected; the sanctioned repair is the formal external pinned install.
